calculator_engine: function balTransfer(outstanding,old,newR,years,fee){const n=years*12;function emi(r){const m=r/100/12;return outstanding*m*Math.pow(1+m,n)/(Math.pow(1+m,n)-1);}const oldEMI=emi(old);const newEMI=emi(newR);const saving=oldEMI-newEMI;return{oldEMI,newEMI,saving,total:saving*n-fee,breakeven:(fee/saving).toFixed(0)};}
